summary:
再生元製藥公布強勁季度財報，EPS大幅優於預期且營收年增雙位數。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）達 14.29 美元，優於預期的 10.21 美元，驚喜幅度達 39.99%
• 季度營收達到 42.9 億美元，較去年同期成長 16.73%
• 核心產品銷售動能強勁，帶動獲利能力提升
• 目前本益比為 19.42，估值具備合理支撐
ai_view:
觀點：本次財報展現強勁的營收與獲利超預期表現，傳遞出核心業務穩健成長的積極訊號。對短中期股價具備正面意涵，有助於推動估值修復。後續應持續追蹤核心藥品市佔率、研發管線進展及政策監管動向。

需留意：生技製藥產業競爭加劇，潛在專利到期風險；總體經濟環境及藥價審查政策可能對利潤率造成壓力

summary_en:
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals reported strong quarterly earnings with a significant EPS beat and double-digit revenue growth.
• EPS came in at $14.29, beating the estimated $10.21 with a surprise of 39.99%
• Quarterly revenue reached $4.29B, representing a 16.73% year-over-year increase
• Strong sales momentum in core products drove profitability improvements
• Trailing P/E ratio stands at 19.42, providing reasonable valuation support

ai_view_en:
view: The strong revenue and earnings beat delivers a positive signal of robust core business growth. This provides a favorable near-to-mid-term implication for the stock price, supporting valuation recovery. Key metrics to track include core drug market share, pipeline progress, and regulatory updates.

Watch：Heightened competition in the biopharmaceutical sector and potential patent expiration risks; Macroeconomic environment and drug pricing regulatory scrutiny could pressure profit margins
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 實際值 14.29 美元顯著高於預期之 10.21 美元。
